description:
"What is <macro indicator> / is it high vs history / how has it moved" — ONE FRED series, feature-extracted.
    Pass a macro CONCEPT (the server resolves it to the canonical series_id + the right transform) or an exact id.
    Returns `series` (transformed points) + an `analysis` block: `latest` (+date — always say as-of-when), `trend`,
    `change` (vs prior/YoY/window), `peak`/`trough`, and 🔑 `percentile`+`z_score` vs the window's own history (the
    money-shot for "high or low?" — e.g. unemployment 8th pct = historically very low), `volatility`, a one-line
    `read`. 🔵 `transform` matters and is auto-picked from the resolved series ("inflation" = pc1 YoY % of a price
    index, a rate = lin) — override only deliberately. QUOTE the `read`; narrate the percentile. Compare two = call
    once per concept and diff. A concept that isn't a FRED series (ISM/PMI, a commodity SPOT price → pulse(kind='commodity'))
    → honest no_match, not a fabrication. US-govt series are public domain (`_license_note`).

context.description: OPTIONAL but RECOMMENDED — the user's FULL request VERBATIM (any language). Used to pick the right series VARIANT (headline vs core, SA vs NSA). e.g. 'is US core inflation still sticky?'
context.title: Context

country.description: OPTIONAL ISO-2 to bias a CONCEPT to a country's series (JP, DE) — the nationality from the question goes HERE, not in `series_id`. FRED intl coverage is uneven; omit for US (default).
country.title: Country

from_.description: Start — ISO date or relative window `10y`/`5y`/`qtd` (dynamic, anchored to today).
from_.title: From

q.description: A macro CONCEPT (any language — 'inflation', 'core PCE', 'unemployment rate', '10y yield', 'อัตราว่างงาน') OR an exact FRED series_id you already hold (CPIAUCSL). The SERVER resolves a concept → the canonical series + the RIGHT transform (no separate lookup). 🌐 a macro concept is safest in ENGLISH (a native concept may drift). 🔴 Pass the user's FULL request in `context` so the server picks the right VARIANT (headline vs CORE CPI, SA vs NSA, PCE vs CPI). ⛔ ONE concept per call — compare two = call twice + diff. For a NON-US concept put the country in `country`, NOT in this field ('Japanese inflation' → series_id='inflation', country='JP').
q.title: Q

transform.description: FRED units transform — `lin` (level: a rate/ratio) · `pc1` (YoY %: inflation/price index) · `pca` (annualized %: real GDP) · `pch` (period %) · `chg`/`ch1` (abs Δ). Omit → the resolved series' suggested transform.
transform.title: Transform
